description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Change one of YOUR clones' trading settings — is_trading (start/pause), event_card_trading_enabled + event_card_filters (trade event cards), arena_trading_enabled, catalog_trading_enabled + catalog_watchlist, tge_trading_enabled, perpetual_markets (the 5-minute binary UP/DOWN prediction markets, e.g. 'BTC,ETH' or 'NONE') + strategy_override (the rule that picks YES/NO each epoch, e.g. 'FADEX' = fade extremes / mean reversion), stop_loss_pct (1-20), take_profit_pct (5-100), max_position_pct (1-50), max_open_positions, min_ai_confidence, min_volume_24h_usd, name. Same fields and bounds as the REST twin PATCH /api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/settings; unknown fields are rejected by name.

event_card_filters.description: max_position_usdc, min_abs_sentiment, min_impact_score, direction_override, take_profit_pct, stop_loss_pct

event_card_trading_enabled.description: Let the bot trade LIVE event cards (EVCDX-*)

perpetual_markets.description: 5-minute binary prediction markets (perpetual epochs) this bot trades: comma-separated symbols, e.g. 'BTC,ETH', or 'NONE' to turn them off. Paper bots paper-trade, live bots trade live; position size and stops still apply. An unavailable symbol is rejected with the list that is.

strategy_override.description: Rule that decides YES/NO on the 5-minute binary markets: 'FADEX' (fade extremes / mean reversion: NO after a 2-sigma stretch up, YES after a 2-sigma stretch down), 'DELTA' (revert big prior-epoch moves), 'CARL' (against the crowd), 'RSI', 'BOLL', 'HELIX', 'CORR', ... 'inherit' restores the template rule.
